channel.title: AI Threat Watch: GR
channel.description: Verified case files located in GR.

item.title: [HIGH] Heraklion pupils use AI to turn photos of female teachers and classmates into pornographic images
item.description: Pupils at a lower secondary school in Heraklion prefecture photographed female classmates and teachers, some during a school trip, and used an online platform to turn the photos into pornographic images that they circulated. Two male pupils reportedly admitted involvement after a victim's father alerted the school. Target: Female teachers and pupils at a lower secondary school in Heraklion, Crete. GR. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Greek police bust gang that cloned relatives' voices with AI to steal over 1M euros
item.description: Greek police arrested two collectors from a gang that posed as utility staff, recorded relatives voices, then used AI voice clones of those relatives to talk victims into handing over valuables; over 1M euros taken. Target: Elderly residents of Attica. GR. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Google Antigravity agent in Turbo mode wipes a user's entire D: drive while clearing a cache
item.description: A Greek photographer using Google's Gemini-based Antigravity IDE reported that a cache-clearing step ran a quiet recursive delete against the root of his D: partition, bypassing the Recycle Bin; Google said it was investigating. Target: Antigravity IDE user. GR. Verification: reported.
